careers.summary: Ensures software reliability through rigorous test case design, exploratory defect hunting, and automation suites.

careers.responsibilities: Analyze requirements to produce comprehensive test matrices; execute functional and regression tests; verify API payloads with Postman; report structured defects in Jira; automate regression workflows.
careers.entry_level_tasks: Write and execute manual test cases; reproduce customer-reported bugs with reproduction steps; test API response status codes and schema contracts; write automated smoke scripts.
careers.education_notes: BS in Software Engineering or Computer Science. Coursework in Software Quality Assurance, Software Engineering, and Database Systems.

careers.summary: Transforms raw organizational data into actionable business intelligence, dashboards, and quantitative insights.

careers.responsibilities: Extract and transform relational data using SQL; clean messy datasets with Python; design executive dashboards in PowerBI or Tableau; perform exploratory data analysis.
careers.entry_level_tasks: Write SQL queries to answer operational business questions; build weekly automated KPI reports; validate data pipelines for missing or anomalous values.
careers.education_notes: BS in Computer Science, Data Science, or Software Engineering. Strong background in Database Systems, Probability & Statistics, and Discrete Mathematics.

careers.summary: Designs intuitive digital product experiences, wireframes, high-fidelity prototypes, and design systems.

careers.responsibilities: Conduct user interviews and card sorting; create user flows and information architecture; design component-driven UI systems in Figma; run usability evaluation sessions.
careers.entry_level_tasks: Design high-fidelity mobile and desktop mockups; build interactive Figma prototypes; maintain design tokens and component variants; document design specifications for developers.
careers.education_notes: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Digital Arts. Coursework in Human-Computer Interaction, Design Thinking, and Web Technologies.

careers.responsibilities: Monitor SIEM alerts and security logs; conduct vulnerability scans; audit server configurations; analyze network traffic anomalies; assist with security incident triage.
careers.entry_level_tasks: Analyze authentication logs for brute-force attempts; run network port scans with Nmap; review web application endpoints against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
careers.education_notes: BS in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering. Coursework in Computer Networks, Information Security, and Operating Systems.
